title: Felicity is Coming!
statementMd:
It's that time of the year, Felicity is around the corner and you can see people celebrating all around the Himalayan region. The Himalayan region has $*n*$ gyms. The $*i*$-th gym has $*g*_{*i*}$ Pokemon in it. There are $*m*$ distinct Pokemon types in the Himalayan region numbered from $1$ to $*m*$. There is a special evolution camp set up in the fest which claims to evolve any Pokemon. The type of a Pokemon could change after evolving, subject to the constraint that if two Pokemon have the same type before evolving, they will have the same type after evolving. Also, if two Pokemon have different types before evolving, they will have different types after evolving. It is also possible that a Pokemon has the same type before and after evolving.

Formally, an *evolution plan* is a permutation $*f*$ of ${1, 2, ..., *m*}$, such that $*f*(*x*) = *y*$ means that a Pokemon of type $*x*$ evolves into a Pokemon of type $*y*$.

The gym leaders are intrigued by the special evolution camp and all of them plan to evolve their Pokemons. The protocol of the mountain states that in each gym, for every type of Pokemon, the number of Pokemon of that type before evolving any Pokemon should be equal the number of Pokemon of that type after evolving all the Pokemons according to the evolution plan. They now want to find out how many distinct *evolution plans* exist which satisfy the protocol.

Two evolution plans $*f*_{1}$ and $*f*_{2}$ are distinct, if they have at least one Pokemon type evolving into a different Pokemon type in the two plans, i. e. there exists an $*i*$ such that $*f*_{1}(*i*) ≠ *f*_{2}(*i*)$.

Your task is to find how many distinct *evolution plans* are possible such that if all Pokemon in all the gyms are evolved, the number of Pokemon of each type in each of the gyms remains the same. As the answer can be large, output it modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$, $1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{6}$) — the number of gyms and the number of Pokemon types.

The next $*n*$ lines contain the description of Pokemons in the gyms. The $*i*$-th of these lines begins with the integer $*g*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *g*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$) — the number of Pokemon in the $*i*$-th gym. After that $*g*_{*i*}$ integers follow, denoting types of the Pokemons in the $*i*$-th gym. Each of these integers is between $1$ and $*m*$.

The total number of Pokemons (the sum of all $*g*_{*i*}$) does not exceed $5·10^{5}$.

## Output

Output the number of valid evolution plans modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

In the first case, the only possible evolution plan is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/09e0e2f9394b52c6493c7865ece6f322b26434eb.png)

In the second case, any permutation of $(1,  2,  3)$ is valid.

In the third case, there are two possible plans:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c8db0de324b08c3f78b8db5ce7a45c1f4e206dcd.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f569c7ffa0111a20a7bedc873c68fdf02d79d08.png)

In the fourth case, the only possible evolution plan is:

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64cf59d705c51be7d92ffd554bfa5d433917bcf8.png)
statementZhMd:
每年的这个时候，Felicity 即将到来，你可以看到整个喜马拉雅地区的人们都在庆祝。喜马拉雅地区有 $*n*$ 个道馆。第 $*i*$ 个道馆中有 $*g*_{*i*}$ 只宝可梦。喜马拉雅地区共有 $*m*$ 种不同的宝可梦，编号从 $1$ 到 $*m*$。庆典中设立了一个特殊的进化营，声称可以让任何宝可梦进化。宝可梦进化后，其种类可能发生变化，但需要满足以下条件：如果两只宝可梦在进化前种类相同，那么它们进化后的种类也相同；如果两只宝可梦在进化前种类不同，那么它们进化后的种类也不同。宝可梦进化前后的种类也可以相同。

形式化地说，一个*进化方案*是 ${1, 2, ..., *m*}$ 的一个排列 $*f*$，其中 $*f*(*x*) = *y*$ 表示一只种类为 $*x*$ 的宝可梦会进化为种类 $*y*$ 的宝可梦。

道馆馆主们对这个特殊的进化营很感兴趣，并计划让他们的宝可梦全部进化。山之协议规定：对于每个道馆和每一种宝可梦，在进化任何宝可梦之前，该种类宝可梦的数量必须等于按照进化方案让所有宝可梦进化之后该种类宝可梦的数量。他们现在想知道满足该协议的不同*进化方案*有多少种。

如果存在至少一种宝可梦类型 $*i*$，使得 $*f*_{1}(*i*) ≠ *f*_{2}(*i*)$，则称两个进化方案 $*f*_{1}$ 和 $*f*_{2}$ 不同。

你的任务是求出所有道馆中的宝可梦全部进化后，每个道馆中每种宝可梦的数量都保持不变时，可能的不同*进化方案*数量。由于答案可能很大，请将其对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后输出。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$，$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{6}$）——道馆数量和宝可梦种类数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述各个道馆中的宝可梦。第 $*i*$ 行首先包含整数 $*g*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *g*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{5}$）——第 $*i*$ 个道馆中的宝可梦数量。接下来有 $*g*_{*i*}$ 个整数，表示第 $*i*$ 个道馆中宝可梦的种类。每个整数都在 $1$ 到 $*m*$ 之间。

宝可梦总数（即所有 $*g*_{*i*}$ 之和）不超过 $5·10^{5}$。

## 输出格式

输出有效进化方案的数量，对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模。

## 说明

在第一种情况中，唯一可能的进化方案是：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/09e0e2f9394b52c6493c7865ece6f322b26434eb.png)

在第二种情况中，$(1,  2,  3)$ 的任意排列都是有效的。

在第三种情况中，有两种可能的方案：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c8db0de324b08c3f78b8db5ce7a45c1f4e206dcd.png)

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5f569c7ffa0111a20a7bedc873c68fdf02d79d08.png)

在第四种情况中，唯一可能的进化方案是：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/64cf59d705c51be7d92ffd554bfa5d433917bcf8.png)
